summary: Elite multi-lens design critique to push the app to designer-crush tier

items.area: Fraunces SOFT + WONK — unlock the signature face (loader + hero cut)
items.change: The css2 request only carries `opsz,wght`, so Fraunces reads generic-elegant. Swap the index.html link to `family=Fraunces:opsz,wght,SOFT,WONK@9..144,400..700,0..100,0..1` (axes alphabetical, lowercase-then-uppercase). Then warm all display type: on the `h1,h2,h3` rule in index.css add `font-variation-settings:'SOFT' 40` (omit opsz so `font-optical-sizing:auto` still governs). Reserve `'WONK' 1` for exactly two spots — the sidebar wordmark and the AskHome hero. On the hero h1, pin the true display cut with `style={{fontVariationSettings:"'opsz' 144,'SOFT' 40,'WONK' 1"}}` (naming opsz overrides optical-sizing:auto, so all three must be listed together). One loader line is the single biggest on-brand typographic upgrade.
items.files: index.html (font link L11), src/index.css (h1,h2,h3 ~L29-34), src/components/shell/Sidebar.tsx (wordmark L38), src/screens/ask/AskHome.tsx (hero h1 L47)

items.area: Single light source — put the top-highlight on every elevation token
items.change: The lit-from-above inset (`inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)`) lives only on `.card` in index.css; the `raised`/`pop`/`lift` boxShadow tokens omit it, so Drawer, CommandPalette, chart tooltip (shadow-pop) and hover cards (shadow-raised) read as a different, edge-lit-less material. Append the inset to each token in tailwind.config.js: `raised: '…, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55)'`, `pop: '…, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6)'` (popovers sit on #FFF, brighter), `lift: '…, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)'`. Highest cohesion-per-line fix in the system; consumers unchanged.

items.area: Uppercase micro-labels breathe — one tracking token
items.change: Every all-caps eyebrow sits at 12px with only `tracking-wide/wider` (0.025–0.05em), well below the ~0.13em small caps need. Add `letterSpacing:{caps:'0.13em'}` to tailwind.config.js and apply `tracking-caps` to: PageHeader kicker (ui.tsx L427), StatTile label (ui.tsx L208), Kv label (ui.tsx L444), ThemeCard category (domain.tsx L98), ThemeDetail category + opportunity/accounts eyebrows (ThemeDetail.tsx L61,L137,L150). Bonus: prefix the PageHeader kicker with a thin 16px rust rule/em-dash for a masthead feel. One token fixes a dozen sites.

items.area: One vertical rhythm + kill the KPI orphan
items.change: The two flagship screens run different grids: StateOfCustomer is built on 20px (mb-5/gap-5 at L25,33,35,53) while ThemeDetail/PageHeader use 24px (mt-6/gap-6/mb-6). Migrate StateOfCustomer's 5s to the 6-step (gap-6, mb-6; mb-8 to separate the KPI band). Same file, fix the ragged 5-tile grid: `grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5` (L25) leaves a 4+1 orphan — switch to `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5` for a balanced 3+2 fallback that never strands a lone tile.

items.area: Unify the interaction grammar — two curves, one focus language, real click physics
items.change: ease-spring is defined in tailwind.config.js but used only in Button, and `--ease-out` is a bare CSS var so cards/tabs silently fall back to browser `ease` — three curves in practice. Expose BOTH as `transitionTimingFunction` tokens (spring + ease-out) and apply the split everywhere: interactions spring (Toggle knob ui.tsx L345, Tabs L246, ThemeChip domain.tsx L81), entrances/shadows ease-out. Give clickable cards genuine physics like Button has — `transition-[transform,box-shadow] duration-200 ease-spring hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-raised active:translate-y-0 active:shadow-card` on ThemeCard (domain.tsx L95), AskHome saved-answer rows, and StateOfCustomer at-risk rows — while StatTile stays static, restoring the clickable/display distinction. Finally collapse the two focus languages: index.css `:where(...):focus-visible` uses a hardcoded 8px radius that mismatches rounded-lg/2xl and loses to inputs' soft `focus:ring-rust/25` — drop the hardcoded radius (outline auto-follows), move inputs from `focus:` to `focus-visible:` at rust/45, so keyboard focus is one kit-wide grammar.
items.files: tailwind.config.js (transitionTimingFunction), src/index.css (focus-visible ~L40-43), src/components/ui.tsx (Toggle, Tabs, Button, SearchInput/TextInput/Select), src/components/domain.tsx (ThemeCard, ThemeChip), src/screens/ask/AskHome.tsx, src/screens/executive/StateOfCustomer.tsx

items.area: Data-viz motion consistency — the hero chart and bars build like the sparklines
items.change: SentimentArea sets `isAnimationActive={false}` on all three Areas (charts.tsx L97-99) while Sparkline self-draws via `draw-in .8s` — the biggest chart on State of the Customer just appears. Turn it on: `animationDuration={800} animationEasing="ease-out"` and stagger the diverging triad bottom-up (`animationBegin` neg 0 / neu 120 / pos 240). Recharts ignores prefers-reduced-motion, so gate with the same INSTANT flag in motion.tsx (duration 0 when INSTANT). Separately, index.css defines `@keyframes bar-grow` that nothing uses — wire it into BarList fills (charts.tsx L126, `transform-origin:left`, staggered `animationDelay:i*40ms`) and grow ThemeDetail's 8 volume columns up (`scaleY`, origin bottom); give Meter/ImpactBar `transition-[width] duration-500 ease-spring` so they animate on value change when filters recompute.
items.files: src/components/charts.tsx (SentimentArea L89-100, BarList L126), src/components/ui.tsx (Meter L178), src/components/domain.tsx (ImpactBar L129), src/screens/themes/ThemeDetail.tsx (L104), src/components/motion.tsx (INSTANT export)

items.area: Empty states — wire the real gap + ship an on-brand illustration
items.change: ThemesExplorer maps themes straight into a grid (L72-77) with no zero-result branch — the one screen whose whole job is filtering drops to blank canvas when nothing matches. Add `{themes.length === 0 && <EmptyState .../>}` (EmptyState already exists ui.tsx L389) with a Clear-filters action, and the same guard on ThemeDetail's feedback list (L126) when the channel filter yields nothing. Upgrade EmptyState's generic gray circle to a ~120px inline-SVG lighthouse on a rock with a horizon line and a faint brass beam on a slow opacity/rotate loop — closes a functional hole and earns its own zoomed screenshot.

items.area: Rust accent materiality — lit gradient fills sitting in recessed wells
items.change: Rust is a dead-flat fill everywhere (primary Button ui.tsx L17, BarList bars charts.tsx L126, Meter/ImpactBar `bg-rust`, ThemeDetail volume `bg-rust/80`) — the templated tell — and every track uses `paper-sunken` with no inset, so the groove sits on the same plane as the fill (zero depth). Ship two utilities in index.css @layer components: `.fill-rust` = `linear-gradient(180deg,#C1512A,#B4451F)` + `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18)` + `0 1px 2px rgba(143,52,23,.35)`; `.well` = `inset 0 1px 2px rgba(28,24,21,.06)`. Apply `.fill-rust` to the primary button and every rust bar/meter, `.well` to their tracks — the sunken/raised polarity finally does real work instead of being color-only.
items.files: src/index.css (new .fill-rust + .well), src/components/ui.tsx (btnVariants.primary L17, Meter L177-178), src/components/charts.tsx (BarList L125-126), src/components/domain.tsx (ImpactBar L128-129), src/screens/themes/ThemeDetail.tsx (L101,L104)

items.area: Keeper's-light wash + a first-class brass token
items.change: The only branded gradient at rest is AskHome's hero glow; everywhere else the paper is flat grain with no directional light — yet the brand is a lighthouse. Add a fixed raking wash below the grain: `body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;background:radial-gradient(115% 75% at 12% -8%, rgba(180,69,31,.05), transparent 55%)}` (anchor app content in a `relative` wrapper). And promote the beam's magic-number gold — `rgba(201,162,39,.30)` in fx.tsx L72 — to `colors.beacon{DEFAULT:'#C9A227',soft:'#E3C766',deep:'#9A7A18'}` in tailwind.config.js, then reuse it for every light moment (Konami beam, AskHome beacon, Nightfall). This establishes a deliberate two-accent language: rust = structure/brand, brass = the light itself.
items.files: src/index.css (body::before below grain L26), tailwind.config.js (colors.beacon), src/components/fx.tsx (swap hardcoded rgba L72), src/components/shell/AppShell.tsx (verify relative wrapper stacking)

items.area: Customer verbatims — editorial pull-quotes, the emotional core
items.change: FeedbackQuote sets the quote in Inter body with literal inline curly quotes (`“{item.text}”` domain.tsx L53). Verbatims appear on nearly every screen and should feel like quoted human speech. Set the text in `font-display italic text-[15px] leading-snug` (Fraunces italic is beautiful and used nowhere), drop the inline quote glyphs, and hang an oversized decorative open-quote — absolutely-positioned `“` in `font-display text-rust/25 text-[40px] leading-none` top-left, with the block given `pl-6` so text optically hangs off it. Keep the SentimentDot and meta row. Turns a flat card into a magazine pull-quote and instantly differentiates the product.

Toasts enter with `toast-in .3s` (fx.tsx L86) but are yanked from the DOM at 2600ms (L31) with zero exit — the most visible motion gap. Add a two-phase teardown: at ~2400ms flag the toast `leaving` and play a `toast-out` keyframe (accelerating out — `translateY(6px) scale(.98); opacity:0` over 180ms with `cubic-bezier(.4,0,1,1)`), unmount on animationend. Enter decelerates, exit accelerates — that asymmetry reads as crafted. Second, give the stack container a FLIP/`transition-transform` reflow (or animate max-height/margin collapse on the leaving node) so survivors glide up instead of snapping. The #1 thing motion-literate designers screenshot.
items.files: src/components/fx.tsx (toast lifecycle L28-32, stack L81-92), src/index.css (toast-out keyframe)

items.area: Sliding active indicator — one shared-element motion across Tabs and Sidebar
items.change: The Tabs underline is a per-button absolute `<span class="absolute inset-x-2 -bottom-px h-0.5 bg-rust">` (ui.tsx L252) that hard-cuts between tabs. Replace with ONE rail on the tablist that translates/scales to the active tab's offsetLeft/offsetWidth via `transition-transform duration-300 ease-spring`. Mirror it on the Sidebar: today active is a static `h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-rust` dot (Sidebar.tsx L58) plus a per-item `bg-sidebar-sel` fill — add a single rust marker rail that animates its Y between nav items on route change. Same gesture, two surfaces, one motion vocabulary — the closest thing to shared-element-between-routes the app is missing.

items.area: AskHome living rotating beacon — the wallpaper screenshot
items.change: The /ask hero sits on a static glow-pulse radial blob (AskHome.tsx L38-42). Augment it with a slow-rotating conic beam anchored under the headline so the lighthouse is visibly scanning: `background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent 0deg,rgba(201,162,39,.22) 16deg,rgba(180,69,31,.10) 30deg,transparent 46deg); maskImage:radial-gradient(circle,#000 28%,transparent 72%); filter:blur(6px); animation:beacon-rotate 14s linear infinite`. Keep the glow-pulse core underneath as the stationary lamp. Add `@keyframes beacon-rotate{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}` to index.css (use the new beacon token); the existing prefers-reduced-motion rule neutralizes it. No layout change.

Add a scoped Present toggle in StateOfCustomer's PageHeader actions (moon/beacon icon) that wraps <Screen> in a `data-night` container — NOT a global theme, so light stays the product default and this is one bold intentional surface. In night: background → deep warm-ink #14100C, cards → #1E1813 with border-white/8 and the top-highlight flipped to rgba(255,255,255,.06), text ink→paper. Behind the 5-tile KPI band run the existing beam-sweep keyframe on a slow 7s infinite loop (rust→brass gradient, blur(12px)), and give the KPI digits a beacon glow `text-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(201,162,39,.28)`. Reads literally as the State of the Customer seen from a lighthouse at night. Pairs with a beam-reveal load: stagger each StatTile's CountUp ~90ms L→R (add a `delay` prop to CountUp) so digits ignite in the beam's wake.
items.files: src/screens/executive/StateOfCustomer.tsx, src/components/ui.tsx (Screen night prop/data-attr), src/index.css (night scope + beam-sweep infinite variant), src/components/motion.tsx (CountUp delay prop)
